footer.tagline: Movimiento tranquilo y deliberado para profesionales ocupados

hero.titleAfter: , incluso en tu semana más ocupada.
hero.subtitle: Northside Pilates combina entrenamiento en reformer y mat en clases pequeñas y enfocadas diseñadas para adaptarse a tu calendario, no al revés.
hero.primaryCta: Reserva tu clase de prueba gratuita

values.title: Diseñado para calendarios ocupados
values.subtitle: Diseñamos el estudio alrededor de cómo viven realmente los profesionales ocupados, no alrededor de un horario rígido.

items.title: Early and late class times
items.description: Sessions start at 6am and run through 8:30pm, so a class fits before work, at lunch, or on the way home.

items.title: Lunch-length options
items.description: Our 45-minute Lunch Express class is built to start and end inside a standard midday break.

items.title: No long-term contracts
items.description: Pause, adjust, or cancel your membership whenever your schedule changes. Nothing is locked in.

items.title: Locker, towel and shower service
items.description: Come straight from the office and head back looking and feeling put together.

classTypes.title: Encuentra tu ritmo
classTypes.subtitle: Cada clase está limitada a ocho personas, por lo que recibes atención personalizada sin importar qué formato elijas.

items.title: Reformer Fundamentals
items.description: Build strength and control on the reformer with precise, low-impact sequences. Ideal if you're new to Pilates or returning after time away.

items.title: Reformer Flow
items.description: A faster-paced reformer class linking movement with breath for a full-body, higher-energy session.

items.title: Mat & Core
items.description: Classic mat work focused on core stability and posture, the deep muscles a day at a desk tends to neglect.

items.title: Private Sessions
items.description: One-to-one coaching tailored to injury recovery, a specific goal, or simply your own pace.

items.title: Lunch Express (45)
items.description: A condensed 45-minute reformer class designed to fit neatly into a midday break.

items.title: Prenatal Pilates
items.description: Gentle, trimester-appropriate movement guided by instructors trained in prenatal care.

instructors.title: Enseñado por personas que han hecho el trabajo
instructors.subtitle: Las clases pequeñas significan coaching real. Cada instructor en Northside está certificado y capacitado para enseñar a la persona frente a ellos, no a un guión.

items.name: Elena Marsh
items.bio: Trained in classical and contemporary Pilates over twelve years, Elena designs every reformer program at Northside.

items.name: James Okafor
items.bio: A former physiotherapist, James specializes in rehabilitation-focused programming for desk-bound professionals.

items.name: Priya Nandan
items.bio: Priya has guided clients through safe, supportive movement before and after birth for over eight years.

schedule.title: Planifica tu semana con nosotros
schedule.subtitle: Una semana completa de sesiones de reformer, mat y privadas programadas alrededor de la jornada laboral.

items.quote: I can get a full class in before my 9am meeting and still feel human for the rest of the day.
items.name: Marcus Webb

items.quote: The Lunch Express class is the only reason I still take a real lunch break.
items.name: Sana Qureshi

items.quote: Small classes make a real difference. The instructors actually correct your form instead of just counting reps.
items.name: David Chen

pricing.title: Opciones de membresía simples
pricing.subtitle: Elige un plan que se adapte a la frecuencia con la que realísticamente puedas asistir. Cambia cuando quieras.

plans.name: Drop-In
plans.description: Try any class with no commitment.

plans.name: Unlimited Monthly

features: Bring a friend once a month

plans.description: Flexible credits for a lighter, irregular schedule.

freeTrial.title: Tu primera clase es por nuestra cuenta
freeTrial.subtitle: Cuéntanos un poco sobre ti y reservaremos un lugar en la clase que se ajuste a tu horario.
freeTrial.successMessage: Revisa tu bandeja de entrada, hemos enviado los horarios de las clases e indicaciones del estudio.
freeTrial.successBody: Revisa tu correo electrónico para acceder a tu semana gratuita de clases. ¡Comienza cuando quieras!
